screen.description: Look at a fresh desktop. region null is the whole desktop, otherwise native [x, y, width, height]. Python crops real pixels and asks LFM. Returns the stored PNG, the mapping, the report, the rewritten scene, and marks. Each mark has label, image_id, bbox_2d in [0, 1000], desktop.box, and desktop.center. One image is image_id 0. Wording does not crop. Unknown is not empty. This tool does not take observation. An observation fails the process.

images.description: Look again at stored PNGs. Each view copies path, origin, and scale from a receipt, plus a native region or null. Python prepares the pixels. A path is not an image you have seen. This tool does not take observation. An observation fails the process.

click.description: Click desktop.center from a mark receipt. Never click bbox_2d. The shared observation then looks at the fresh screen.

drag.description: Hold the left button and move through desktop.center points from mark receipts, for the given seconds. Never use bbox_2d as a pixel. The shared observation looks after the stroke.

type_text.description: Paste Unicode into the focused control. Establish focus first. The shared observation checks the result.

keys.description: Press one chord of PyAutoGUI key names. Use another call for the next chord. The shared observation checks the result.

scroll.description: Scroll the focused window by signed wheel ticks, positive upward. The shared observation checks the viewport.

python.description: Run the async Python you wrote, with host, ROOT, and asyncio. The shared observation looks after the code returns.

chat.description: Send text to Wojciech's private Telegram chat. Delivery is only delivery. It does not do the desktop work and it does not change mode. The shared observation does not prove he read it.

dial.description: Call Wojciech and say text. The wav is synthesized before the phone rings, then played the moment he answers, so the call does not open in silence. Requires transport.call down. If the call is already up, speak instead. An unanswered call returns call down and leaves the process up. The call is not the goal.

answer.description: Accept the ringing call and open audio. Requires transport.call ringing. Ringing is not the owner goal.

speak.description: Speak ordered short phrases. While call is up, play them on the call. While call is not up, send each wav as a Telegram audio file he can play. A receipt does not prove he heard it. Hearing keeps transcribing.

hang.description: End the live Telegram call. Requires a current call id. A down call has nothing to hang and this fails. Hanging up keeps the owner goal and open work.

files.description: Read the files in the Trident root. This tool does not take observation. An observation fails the process.

wait.description: Pause until he speaks or the desktop changes. Last call in the batch.

finish.description: Close the task. completed when you have seen it done. cancelled when he cancelled it. paused keeps it unfinished. shutdown true ends the process and requires the call to be down. Last call in the batch.

goal.description: Name the task you are doing. retain_previous true keeps a different unfinished task. Requires observation.

observation.description: Required on every observe=true call. expected is the hoped-for change, not a fact. question is a separate next-plan question. region is a native crop or null. relation ties this look to earlier looks. Python crops, asks LFM, and maps each bbox_2d to desktop.center. Pixel size is not sent to LFM.
